title: Ashbury Rewards Console Reference: Relocation Compensation Posting
content:
When a hotel relocates a reservation credited to the membership, the member receives relocation compensation posted with earning source `relocation_compensation` and the relocated reservation's reference.

## Conditions of the result

- Compensation is posted only for a reservation whose status is relocated.
- When the tier's setting limits relocation compensation to guaranteed reservations, the reservation must have been guaranteed, which every reservation booked under an Ashbury rate plan is, and the rate plan must be eligible for relocation compensation.
- Relocation compensation is posted as one transaction per relocated reservation and is the member's only compensation from Ashbury Rewards for the relocation; guest services adds no other goodwill points.

## Capability

`post_relocation_compensation_5afb8ff3` posts relocation compensation points to an Ashbury Rewards account for a reservation the hotel relocated. One call records one points bonus transaction of source `relocation_compensation` that names the relocated reservation, dated today, and adds the points to the points balance of the membership. The member sees the compensation in their account activity and in their balance straight away.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, giving the name `post_relocation_compensation_5afb8ff3`, and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loyalty_member_id` | Reference number of the Ashbury Rewards membership credited, as returned by the membership lookup for the verified member | Identifier |
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the relocated reservation the compensation is for, as returned by the reservation lookup | Identifier |
| `earning_source` | Business source recorded on the transaction | Closed set of one value: `relocation_compensation` — points owed because the hotel relocated a guaranteed reservation |
| `promotion_code` | Code of a registered promotion the points would be earned under, upper-case letters and digits, up to 10 characters | Relocation compensation is earned under no promotion, so the value is the empty string "" |
| `points` | Compensation points posted | Whole number of points, always positive; integer, no decimals, no thousands separators |

## Return

A dictionary string with `transaction_id` (reference number of the bonus transaction created), `loyalty_member_id` (membership credited), `reservation_id` (relocated reservation named), `earning_source` (source recorded), `points` (integer points posted), `posted_date` (posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (points balance once the compensation is added). A returned `transaction_id` means the compensation is posted.

## Input and return (hypothetical values)

A posting of 14000 `points` to an account holding 52000 points returns `points` 14000 and `points_balance` 66000, with today's `posted_date`.
